input.summary: Add a Party right to terminate participation for convenience during the Initial Period on 90 days' notice, with exit charge capped and no capital-cost forfeiture.
input.comment: [Playbook] The 25-year Initial Period currently gives us no exit except unanimous agreement, and Subparagraph 18.5 forfeits our capital-cost credit on exit. We have added a convenience termination right on ninety (90) days' notice with the exit charge capped at three months' O&M share, which is our fallback position; we would accept 30 days' notice with a pro-rata credit as our preferred alternative.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Subparagraphs 18.1 and 18.2, any Party may terminate its participation in this Agreement for convenience, including at any time during the Initial Period, by giving not less than ninety (90) days' prior notice, in writing, to the other Parties. Such Party shall remain liable for its share of APCN 2 Capital Costs and Operation and Maintenance Costs accrued to the effective date of such termination, and any further charge payable by it by reason of such termination shall not exceed three (3) months of its share of Operation and Maintenance Costs. The exclusion of credit for capital costs in Subparagraph 18.5 shall not apply to a termination under this Subparagraph 18.2A.
